findings.description: F-001: both halves of adaptive-board-comparison.png were missing the status and score rows.
findings.resolution: Fixed by the StringVar(master=root) repair and regeneration; both halves now show 'Ход игрока: O' and 'X:0 O:0 Ничьи:0', and the composite was rebuilt from the corrected sources.

findings.description: F-030: in the 'обычный размер' half the 'Новый матч' control button was clipped by the window edge, in the very figure that argues the layout copes with resizing.
findings.resolution: The generator forced 340x420, below the window's natural 345 px minimum. Changed adaptive_board_small() in generate_chapter_17_outputs.py to 380x430 with a matching 460x500 grab box and an explanatory comment. Verified: both controls render fully and large > small still holds on both axes.

findings.description: F-035: the H2 'Поле не должно быть хрупкой грудой фиксированных виджетов' is a calqued metaphor.
findings.resolution: Reworded to 'Поле не должно превращаться в хрупкую конструкцию из виджетов с фиксированным размером'.

evidence.summary: Learning objective and scope: Makes the board grow with the window using grid weights and sticky='nsew' applied at every level of nesting, and is honest about what fixed-size text units can and cannot guarantee.

Both outer.rowconfigure(1, weight=1) on the parent AND sticky='nsew' on board_frame.grid() are required; omitting either stops the board growing vertically. -- confirmed structurally -- tic_tac_toe.py sets both, and the two captured geometries show the board genuinely growing in both axes.

width=3, height=1 on a tk.Button are text units (characters/lines), not pixels, so exact square cells cannot be promised across platforms. -- confirmed -- the Tk button manual defines -width/-height in characters for text buttons and in pixels only for image buttons; the lesson's refusal to promise a square is technically correct and commendably honest.

The comparison screenshot shows the same game state at two window sizes with the cells visibly larger. -- confirmed after remediation -- the two source captures are genuinely different sizes (380x430 and 700x820, composed unscaled at true relative size) and the board visibly grows. As found both halves were blank-labelled (F-001) and the small half clipped a control (F-030); both now fixed.
